warning: COORDINATOR-ONLY: sampling design with per-task strata and historical deltas. Reviewers receive only reviewer-packet/.

provenance.note: provenance is descriptive; the per-answer source path + sha256 in the coordinator map pin the exact bytes

roundRule.description: prefer round 2; if round 2 is unavailable for a chosen answer, fall back deterministically round 1, then round 3; the round is never chosen by score

selectionAlgorithm.name: stratified-sha256-order-sampling
selectionAlgorithm.description: tasks are stratified by the sign of the historical per-task delta (median over three rounds of with-skill minus no-skill); inside each stratum they are ordered by sha256(seed + task id); strata are then filled to their pre-declared targets; if a stratum is short the deficit is drawn from the nearest stratum by a fixed fill order
selectionAlgorithm.deltaDefinition: median over rounds 1,2,3 of (skill - noskill), computed from the per-round aggregate.json artifacts listed in sources.aggregates
selectionAlgorithm.anonymousOrdering: single deterministic Fisher-Yates shuffle over the 32 answers with mulberry32(anonymousOrderSeed); ids R001...R032 handed out in shuffled order; the seed is advanced until no answer keeps its input position (derangement)
selectionAlgorithm.taskLabelOrdering: T01...T16 assigned in order of each task's smallest anonymous answer id

designDisclosures.note: no task in the pool has a negative median delta, so the 3 pre-declared negative slots were filled by zero-delta tasks; with the round-2 rule no sampled pair comes from a round in which the with-skill answer scored lower than the no-skill answer. The review therefore cannot observe grading of skill-arm regressions and must say so when reported.

rules.description: absolute/local path containing the skill repository folder name
path into the skill references/ folder
bare file name of a skill reference card file
skill name (dsh-plugin-upgrade / plugin-upgrade), with a trailing "skill" if present
the word "skill" used as a tool reference (not "skill name"/"skill provider"/"skills"/"(skill)" surface labels)

masking.limitation: word-level only; style, structure, paraphrased references and token density can still hint at the arm

taskMaterials.note: brief + read-only fixture per task, read from git at the pinned round-1 dataset commit (identical at the round-2 and round-3 commits); identical for both arms, so only the skill-identity masking rules are applied

humanReview.note: preparation only: no human review has been performed and no rating exists in this packet; a blank reviewer form means "not reviewed"
